name: Soothing Song
text:
Frequency once per day

---
You perform a song that applies a balm to the soul, soothing listeners and preparing them to keep moving. The Fatigued condition is suppressed for you and all allies within a 30-foot emanation until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain the aura up to 1 minute. In addition, you and all allies in the aura gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.
